edges.reason: owner is assigned directly from the caller-controlled msg.sender in the constructor.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the allowance spender and as implicit _from when called via transfer.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], taking msg.sender as the allowance owner.
delegate gates the delegatecall only on msg.sender == owner.
_mints requires msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded address before overwriting balances.
init requires msg.sender == owner before mutating sale parameters.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before debiting balances.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before setting the whitelist address.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender and grants it the full supply.
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transfer immediately calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls ensure() as its authorization gate before moving balances.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer.
transferFrom mutates balances and allowance with raw unchecked subtraction.
ensure calls pairFor to compute the canonical Uniswap pair address for this token.
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) when the caller is not whitelisted.
ensure compares _from and _to against owner for a whitelist bypass.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to grant an unconditional bypass.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress for a whitelist bypass.
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] and compares it against _saleNum.
condition checks _minSale against _value.
condition checks _maxSale against _value.
condition uses _saleNum to cap the number of sales per address.
approve overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with the supplied value.
delegate executes delegatecall(a, b) on an attacker-supplied address in this contract's storage context.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, permanently whitelisting that address.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with a caller-influenced value.
_mints scales addedValue by 10**decimals.
init writes the scaled token value into _minSale.
init writes the scaled maxToken value into _maxSale.
init writes saleNum into _saleNum.
init computes token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) without overflow protection.
batchSend computes uint total = _value * _tos.length with no SafeMath, allowing overflow.
batchSend debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits each balanceOf[_tos[i]].
setTradeAddress overwrites tradeAddress with the supplied address.
Constructor initializes owner.
Constructor mints the whole supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the Uniswap router.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
Constructor assigns the token name.
Constructor assigns the token symbol.
callOptionalReturn performs address(token).call(data), forwarding all gas to untrusted token code before state checks complete.
batchSend iterates over the _tos recipient array parameter.
batchSend multiplies the _value parameter by the recipient count.
ensure receives _from and applies the whitelist / condition logic to it.
ensure forwards _value into condition for min/max sale checks.
transferFrom uses the _from parameter as the debited balance holder.
transferFrom uses the _to parameter as the credited balance holder.
approve uses _spender as the allowance key.
delegate uses parameter a as the delegatecall target.
delegate uses parameter b as the delegatecall calldata.
_mints uses parameter spender as the balance and whitelist key.
init assigns parameter saleNum to _saleNum.
init scales parameter maxToken into _maxSale.
setTradeAddress writes parameter addr into tradeAddress.
ensure compares the _to parameter against owner for the whitelist bypass.
condition indexes _onSaleNum with the _from parameter.
Local total is computed and used to debit msg.sender inside batchSend.
Local loop index i drives the batchSend distribution loop.
Loop-local _to receives balanceOf credit inside batchSend.
pairFor returns the locally computed pair address.
pairFor derives token0 from the ordering of tokenA and tokenB.
pairFor derives token1 from the ordering of tokenA and tokenB.
